summary: OnePlus CPH2487, Android 16 (API 36), Arm64 CPU with ExecuTorch 1.4.1 and XNNPACK.

checks.Held-out Android triage: 17/18 defects sent to Hold or Review. 6/11 good samples passed. One discoloration sample was a false Pass.
checks.Imported image timing: 100 model passes after 10 warm-up passes. Median 4.24 ms and p95 9.54 ms. Excludes file decoding and preview rendering.
checks.Live rear-camera timing: 100 analyzed frames after warm-up. 12.7 analyzed FPS, 9.78 ms median and 15.77 ms p95 vision analysis. Camera stream check without factory parts.
checks.Local Llama advisory: Llama chose a surface check for a scratch and a dimensional check for a bend. First token in 1.16 s and 0.91 s. Initial load took 4.10 s. The app supplied the evidence summaries.
checks.Inspection history and CSV: History still showed the saved records after app restart. Android's file picker exported 11 rows with the result, location, recommendation source, and timings.
checks.Network isolation: The APK declares camera permission only. Both inference paths use local files. A complete handset airplane-mode run remains unverified.
